Three laptops fit best under ₹50,000 all with 16GB RAM and a 512GB SSD:

Laptop	Price	Processor	RAM
Acer Aspire 14 AI	About ₹43,999	Snapdragon X (X1-26-100)	16GB
Lenovo ThinkBook 16	About ₹46,990	Ryzen 5 7535HS	16GB
Acer Aspire 3 (A324-53)	About ₹40,990 to ₹49,990	Core i5-1334U	16GB
Best for speed: the ThinkBook 16. Its chip is a stronger type than the one in most cheaper laptops, but the 16-inch body is big.
Best for battery: the Aspire 14 AI, and it is the cheapest of the strong options.
Best on a tight budget: the Aspire 3, if you find it near ₹40,990.

These prices come from one guide (last updated Fri 23 Oct) that did not test the laptops itself. The same laptop can differ by ₹15,000 or more between sellers, so check the live price and exact AI number before buying. Nothing was booked or bought.
